q: The board expressed strong ___ for the expansion plan.
note: 形容詞 strong 後面要名詞。★ 冠詞或形容詞後面的空格，先往名詞找。

q: The new hires completed the orientation ___ within the first week.
note: 修飾動詞 completed 要副詞。★ 句子已完整，拿掉也通順的就是副詞。

q: Please provide a ___ description of the problem so we can assist you.
note: 冠詞 a 與名詞 description 之間要形容詞。

q: The ___ of the new branch has been delayed until September.
note: The ___ of 結構要名詞。★ opening 在這裡是動名詞轉名詞（開幕）。

q: Our customer service team responds to inquiries ___ and courteously.
note: and 後面是副詞 courteously，前面要對稱。★ 對稱結構是最快的判斷法。

q: The manager requested a ___ review of the department's spending.
note: a ___ review 中間要形容詞。★ 陷阱：through 是介系詞，跟 thorough 只差一個字母。

q: Attendance has grown ___ since the workshop series began.
note: 修飾動詞 has grown 要副詞。

q: The firm is known for the ___ of its financial reporting.
note: the ___ of 要名詞。★ accuracy 是標準名詞形，accurateness 不是常用字。

q: All equipment must be handled with ___ care during transport.
note: 名詞 care 前面要形容詞。★ with + 形容詞 + 名詞 是常見結構。

q: The ___ between the two departments has improved considerably.
note: The ___ between 要名詞。

q: Ms. Ferreira is ___ qualified for the position of regional director.
note: 修飾形容詞 qualified 要副詞。★ highly qualified 是固定搭配，不能用 high。

q: The report offers a ___ analysis of consumer trends in the region.
note: a ___ analysis 中間要形容詞。

q: Employees should keep their contact information ___ at all times.
note: keep + 受詞 + 形容詞。★ 陷阱：currently 是副詞，不能當受詞補語。

q: The company has made a significant ___ in renewable energy.
note: a significant ___ 要名詞。

q: The instructions were written ___ so that anyone could follow them.
note: 修飾過去分詞 written 要副詞。

q: There has been a noticeable ___ in customer complaints this quarter.
note: a noticeable ___ in 要名詞。

q: The proposal was ___ received by everyone at the meeting.
note: 修飾動詞 received 要副詞。

q: Safety training is a ___ part of every new employee's first month.
note: a ___ part 中間要形容詞，required 當形容詞用。

q: The delivery truck ___ at the loading dock when the alarm sounded.
note: when + 過去式短動作，背景用過去進行式。

q: By next December, Mr. Sarr ___ with the company for a decade.
note: By + 未來時間 → 未來完成式。

q: The technician ___ the machine twice before it finally started.
note: before + 過去式 → 更早的動作用過去完成式。

q: Our office ___ recycling bins on every floor since last spring.
note: since + 過去時間點 → 現在完成式。

q: The catering staff ___ the banquet hall at six tomorrow evening.
note: 未來某時刻正在進行 → 未來進行式。★ at six tomorrow 是未來的時間點。

q: Ms. Cortez ___ three international projects during her time in Berlin.
note: during her time in Berlin 指已結束的過去期間 → 過去式。

q: The system ___ automatically every night at midnight.
note: every night 是習慣 → 現在簡單式。

q: We ___ the contract as soon as the legal team approves the final draft.
note: as soon as 子句用現在式，主句用未來式。★ 時間副詞子句不用未來式，這是常考點。

q: Prices for raw materials ___ steadily over the past eighteen months.
note: over the past + 期間 → 現在完成式。

q: Before the software was upgraded, staff ___ to enter the data manually.
note: Before + 過去式 → 主句用過去完成式。★ had to 的完成式是 had had to。

q: The museum ___ its doors at five o'clock on weekdays.
note: 營業時間是常態 → 現在簡單式。

q: The award ceremony ___ in the main auditorium next Friday.
note: 典禮是被舉辦的 → 未來被動。

q: Visitors ___ to sign in at the front desk upon arrival.
note: 訪客是被要求的 → 被動。

q: The damaged shipment ___ to the supplier last Tuesday.
note: 貨物是被退回的 → 過去被動。

q: The renovation ___ three months longer than originally estimated.
note: take + 時間是主動用法，沒有被動。★ 陷阱：看到「被估計」就想選被動。

q: All personal data ___ on encrypted servers located within the country.
note: 資料是被儲存的 → 被動。

q: The new policy ___ effect immediately after the announcement.
note: take effect 是固定片語，主動用法。

q: Participants ___ a certificate upon completing all four modules.
note: 人是接受方，用主動 receive。★ 陷阱：中文說「被頒發」，但英文主詞是人時用 receive。

q: The training manual is available ___ request from the HR department.
note: upon request = 應要求提供，固定片語。

q: Sales in the Asian market grew by twelve percent ___ the third quarter.
note: during + 名詞期間。★ 陷阱：while 是連接詞，後面要接子句。

q: The parcel should arrive ___ three business days.
note: within + 時間長度 = 在…之內。

q: Employees are eligible for the bonus ___ completing one full year of service.
note: after + 動名詞。★ since 後面接動名詞不合語意，during 後面不接動名詞。

q: The conference will be held ___ the Grand Hotel in Vancouver.
note: 特定地點用 at。★ at the hotel（點）、in Vancouver（大範圍）。

q: This coupon is valid ___ purchases over fifty dollars only.
note: valid on purchases = 適用於…消費。

q: The department is currently short ___ qualified technicians.
note: be short of = 缺少，固定搭配。

q: Please keep the receipt ___ case you need to exchange the item.
note: in case = 以防萬一，固定片語。

q: The revised figures are consistent ___ last year's audit results.
note: be consistent with = 與…一致。

q: The seminar is open to anyone ___ prior experience in the field.
note: with = 具有。★ anyone with experience 是常見結構。

q: Deliveries are suspended ___ the duration of the road closure.
note: for the duration of = 在…期間內，固定說法。

q: The manager is responsible ___ approving all travel expenses.
note: be responsible for = 負責。★ 注意 responsible to someone 是「對某人負責」，語意不同。

q: ___ the equipment arrives, the installation team will begin work.
note: Once 是連接詞，後面接子句。★ 另外三個都是介系詞。

q: The office will remain open ___ the renovation is completed.
note: until 當連接詞，後面接子句。

q: ___ sales increased, overall profit declined because of higher costs.
note: 後面接子句 → 用連接詞 Although。

q: Not only ___ the deadline, but the team also stayed under budget.
note: Not only 放句首要倒裝。★ 這是 Part 5 難度較高的一題，看到句首 Not only 就找助動詞倒裝。

q: The vendor offers free shipping ___ the order exceeds one hundred dollars.
note: provided that = 只要，連接詞，後面接子句。

q: The flight was delayed; ___, all passengers were rebooked within the hour.
note: 分號後接副詞 nevertheless。★ 跟 however 同一類，是副詞不是連接詞。

q: ___ you have any questions, please contact the support line.
note: Should 放句首 = If you should，正式書信的倒裝條件句。

q: The company relocated its warehouse ___ reduce transportation costs.
note: in order to + 原形動詞。★ so that 後面要接完整子句。

q: Sales rose in the north, ___ the southern region saw a slight decline.
note: whereas = 然而（對比），連接兩個子句。

q: The system will shut down automatically ___ it detects unusual activity.
note: if 是連接詞，後面接子句。

q: ___ hiring more staff, the company invested in automation software.
note: Rather than + 動名詞 = 而不是。★ 其餘三個是連接詞，後面要接子句。

q: The vendor ___ we contacted last month has updated its pricing.
note: 先行詞是人且在子句中當受詞 → whom。★ 空格後面是主詞 we，表示關係代名詞不當主詞。

q: The office ___ was renovated last year now houses the design team.
note: 先行詞是物且在子句中當主詞 → that／which。★ where 後面要接完整句子。

q: We visited the factory ___ the components are assembled.
note: 空格後是完整句子且先行詞是地點 → where。

q: The consultant recommended a strategy ___ results were immediate.
note: whose 也可以用在物：strategy 的 results。★ 空格後直接接名詞就是 whose。

q: ___ the committee decides will be announced on Monday.
note: Whatever = 無論什麼，本身帶先行詞，可當主詞。

q: The year ___ the company was founded is printed on every product label.
note: be founded in a year → 介系詞提前變 in which。

q: The two managers divided the workload between ___.
note: 主詞與受詞是同一群人 → 反身代名詞。

q: If any of the invoices are incorrect, please return ___ to accounting.
note: invoices 是複數 → them。

q: ___ of the applicants has been notified of the interview schedule.
note: 動詞 has 是單數 → Each。★ 其餘三個都要配複數動詞。

q: The team completed the project ___ without outside assistance.
note: team 當單一整體 → itself。★ themself 不是標準用法。

q: This printer is faster than ___ in the other office.
note: 單數可數名詞的替代用 the one。

q: Very ___ of the attendees left before the closing remarks.
note: attendees 是可數複數 → few。★ little 用於不可數。

q: The updated model is considerably ___ to operate than the previous one.
note: than 前面要比較級形容詞。★ 陷阱：more easily 是副詞比較級，這裡需要形容詞。

q: Of the four proposals, this one requires the ___ amount of funding.
note: Of the four → 最高級；amount 是不可數 → least。

q: The second workshop attracted ___ participants than the first.
note: far 可以修飾比較級 more。★ very 不能修飾比較級。

q: Our response time is now half ___ it was two years ago.
note: half what it was = 只有以前的一半。★ what 帶出名詞子句。

q: This is by far the ___ efficient layout we have tested.
note: the + 最高級，by far 加強語氣。

q: The sooner we finalize the design, ___ risk of delay we face.
note: The + 比較級, the + 比較級。★ risk 不可數，用 less。

q: The committee postponed ___ a decision until the report was complete.
note: postpone 後面接動名詞。★ postpone／delay／finish／avoid 都接 -ing。

q: We look forward to ___ from you at your earliest convenience.
note: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞。★ 這是最經典的陷阱之一。

q: The supervisor allowed the team ___ the deadline by two days.
note: allow + 受詞 + to 原形。

q: ___ properly maintained, the machinery can last over twenty years.
note: If (it is) properly maintained，省略了主詞與 be 動詞。

q: The manual is worth ___ before you operate the equipment.
note: be worth + 動名詞，且用主動形表被動意。

q: Staff members are required ___ their timesheets by Friday afternoon.
note: be required to 原形。

q: ___ the presentation, Ms. Aluko answered questions for twenty minutes.
note: 完成式分詞表示先後：先講完才回答問題。

q: The company avoided ___ additional staff by automating the process.
note: avoid 後面接動名詞。

q: The purpose of this memo is ___ everyone of the new parking rules.
note: be 動詞後面接不定詞當主詞補語。

q: We regret ___ you that the position has already been filled.
note: regret to inform = 遺憾地通知（要做的事）。★ regret informing 是「後悔已通知」，語意相反。

q: The supplier failed to ___ the terms of the agreement.
note: comply with = 遵守。

q: Please ___ the enclosed brochure for a full list of services.
note: consult a brochure／manual = 查閱。

q: The airline will ___ passengers for any additional baggage fees.
note: reimburse + 人 = 補償某人。★ refund + 錢，reimburse + 人，受詞不同。

q: All employees must ___ to the company's confidentiality policy.
note: adhere to = 遵守（政策、規範）。

q: The manager will ___ the responsibilities among the three teams.
note: distribute = 分配。★ deliver 是遞送實體物品。

q: Sales representatives are expected to ___ their monthly quotas.
note: fulfill a quota = 達成配額。

q: The department will ___ a survey to measure employee satisfaction.
note: conduct a survey = 進行調查，高頻搭配。

q: Any changes to the schedule will be posted on the ___ board.
note: bulletin board = 公布欄。★ billboard 是戶外大型廣告看板。

q: The warranty does not ___ damage caused by improper use.
note: a warranty covers something = 保固涵蓋。

q: Our records ___ that your subscription expired last month.
note: records indicate that = 紀錄顯示。

q: The firm has decided to ___ its headquarters to a larger building.
note: relocate = 遷移。★ replace 是取代，remove 是移除。

q: Attendance is limited, so early ___ is strongly recommended.
note: early registration = 提早報名，形容詞後接名詞。

q: The technician will ___ the equipment before the inspection.
note: calibrate equipment = 校準設備。★ 四個字拼法接近，是典型的詞彙陷阱。

q: Please ___ your seat belt while the aircraft is taxiing.
note: fasten a seat belt 是固定說法。

q: The new regulation will ___ businesses with fewer than ten employees.
note: exempt = 豁免。★ except 是介系詞，不能直接當及物動詞用。

q: We appreciate your ___ in helping us test the new system.
note: your + 名詞。★ participant 是「參與者」（人），這裡要的是「參與」這件事。

q: The contract clearly ___ the responsibilities of both parties.
note: specify = 明確規定。

q: Overtime pay is calculated ___ an hourly basis.
note: on a ... basis = 以…為基礎，固定片語。

q: The retailer offers a thirty-day ___ period for all electronics.
note: return period = 退貨期，名詞當形容詞用。

q: Applicants should ___ a cover letter along with their résumé.
note: enclose = 隨函附上，書信高頻字。

q: The factory operates at full ___ during the holiday season.
note: at full capacity = 滿載運轉。★ capability 是能力，不用於產能。

q: Management is ___ of the delays and is working on a solution.
note: be aware of = 知悉。

q: The invoice must be paid ___ full within thirty days of receipt.
note: pay in full = 全額付清，固定片語。
